subject.title: Feature: Reminders tab in Mission Control

question: Should reminder separation use a narrow typed cron purpose/display metadata contract with a dedicated Reminders route, or wait behind the broader cron tags/categories design?
rationale: The remaining work crosses persisted cron state, Gateway protocol validation, service filtering, reminder-producing paths, and Control UI behavior, so automation should not choose the durable API/display shape alone.

options.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
options.body: Add a narrow first-party cron purpose/display contract for reminders and build the Reminders tab on that stable shape.

options.title: General tags first
options.body: Make the broader cron tags/categories issue the primary design and implement Reminders only after that API is accepted.

options.title: Cron-only improvements
options.body: Avoid a separate tab and improve Cron filtering/copy only, accepting that reminders remain in the generic scheduled-job list.

recommendation.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
recommendation.body: Add a narrow first-party cron purpose/display contract for reminders and build the Reminders tab on that stable shape.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the closest maintainer-side API/protocol direction on the related cron metadata PR.
